Extension of the existing water supply system in Niamey

description.narrative: The project is defined as the extension of the existing water supply system in Niamey through the rehabilitation of an existing raw water intake, the development, construction, equipping, subsequent commissioning and operation of a new drinking water treatment plant with a capacity of 40,000 m3/day (Goudel IV), and the extension and improvement of the current transmission and distribution network.

Satellite Based Water Monitoring and Flow Forecasting

description.narrative: The project consists of the implementation of the satellite based Energy and Water Balance Monitoring System (EWBMS) which on a daily basis will provide climatic data fields of temperature radiation evapotranspiration and precipitation, and the implementation of the Large Scale Hydrological Model (LSHM) which uses the data from the EWBMS to generate river flow rates and forecasts.
